_comment: USD per 1M tokens. Every model and provider block cites a public pricing URL and the date it was read in its _verify field. 'cached' is the price of a cached input token (cache read). Provider blocks carry cache and batch terms; cache_write_multiplier is the 5-minute cache-write price as a multiple of input, cache_write_1h_multiplier the 1-hour one (default 2.0). A model missing here is reported as unpriced, never guessed. A provider block with cache_mode "implicit" caches prompts by itself, so the report recommends no prompt-caching action for its routes. A provider block with cache_terms_verified false has its cached tokens re-priced at the input rate when another provider's model is costed in --scope open. 'class' (decision, small, mid, frontier) is a hand-set price band, not a quality claim; it drives the other-provider candidates of --scope open. 'tier' drives same-provider routing. A model without 'tier' is never a same-provider routing target; a model without 'class' is never an open-scope candidate.
